question: Which of the following hills are NOT part of the Purvanchal hills?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patli hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__**Purvachal hills**__

__
 
• The range is an eastern extension of the Himalayan Range System, in northeastern India.
 
• It bends sharply to the south beyond the Dihang River gorge and spreads along the eastern boundary of India with Myanmar.
 
• The Purvanchal includes the hill of the Patkai, Barail Range, Naga Hills, Lushai Hills, and Jampui Hills. 
 
• The highest peak of the Purvanchal Range is Mount Dapha.
 
• Patli hills is not part of Purvanchal hills.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __**Patli hills**__

 
• Patli Hills is a range of hills located in the south of Delhi, India.
 
• The hills are a popular tourist destination, and are known for their scenic views of the city.
 
• The hills are also home to a number of temples and historical monuments.
 
• The highest point in the hills is the QutubMinar, which is a 73-meter-tall tower that was built in the 12th century.
 
• The hills are also home to a number of other historical monuments, including the Mehrauli Archaeological Park, the Alai Darwaza, and the Qutub Complex.
 
• The hills are a popular spot for hiking, picnicking, and bird watching.
 
• The hills are also home to a number of wildlife species, including monkeys, peacocks, and snakes.
